overview: yt-dlp brings YouTube downloading into Misty without leaving the app.
capabilities: Convert downloads into MP3, M4A, MP4, or WEBM
Save media into sensible local destinations
permissions: Network access through the verified bundled yt-dlp
Write access to local download folders
Shell access to invoke yt-dlp and FFmpeg
getting_started: Install the yt-dlp app from the Store. Its media tools are included.
Open it from Apps in a workspace tab.
Paste a supported media URL and review the download.
changelog: v0.3.0 - Moved yt-dlp into the workspace app tab with resumable job status.
v0.2.0 - Added media inspection, playlist safeguards, cancellable download jobs, and output reveal.
v0.1.0 - Added the initial yt-dlp panel.
